relation.note: al-Tāj b. ʿArab Shāh took inheritance law (al-farāʾiḍ) from D01751 (D01751 = teacher/active). Provisional TMP-P-000626 (confirmed genuine, no existing AIND): "al-Tāj b. ʿArab Shāh" occurs in the corpus only as an informant of al-Sakhāwī (قال لي / حكى لي، at three places) with no independent tarjama; a member of the Ibn ʿArabshāh family (cf. al-Shihāb Aḥmad b. ʿArabshāh = AIND-D01367 / cross D12534; the ancestor ʿArabshāh b. ʿAlī = AIND-D04899). Registerable as a new person; family link noted.

affiliation.note: Resided at the zāwiya of Aḥmad al-Aqbāʿī. The eponym Aḥmad al-Aqbāʿī = AIND-D01746 ("الماضي قريبا" — the adjacent preceding entry). Institution: provisional TMP-I-00064.

person.note: アフマド・アッ＝シハーブ・アル＝ヒムスィー、後にアッ＝ディマシュキー。ダマスカスに定住し、（本項の少し前に言及された）アフマド・アル＝アクバーイーのザーウィヤに居した。相続法（アル＝ファラーイド）に秀でており、アッ＝ターッジュ・イブン・アラブ・シャーがそれを彼から学んだ。

Aḥmad al-Shihāb al-Ḥimṣī, then al-Dimashqī, who settled in Damascus at the zāwiya of Aḥmad al-Aqbāʿī (mentioned shortly before). He was proficient in inheritance law (al-farāʾiḍ), which al-Tāj b. ʿArab Shāh took from him.
